meta.title: Workspace Checkpoints
meta.description: Keeps a durable git-backed snapshot of the workspace at the start and end of every turn, and reverts chosen files (or a whole turn) after a diff preview and an explicit approval.

card.title: {count} files in this turn’s checkpoint
dialog.title: Revert turn {turn}
dialog.subtitle: Restore workspace files to the state recorded by this turn’s checkpoint.
dialog.none: The selected side holds no file this turn changed.
dialog.diffFailed: The diff could not be read.
dialog.diffTruncated: The comparison is longer than the preview limit.
dialog.stale: Files changed while the preview was open ({paths}). Reopen the preview.
